patterns.message: Only the marketing entrypoints src/pages/company and src/pages/easysubway may import the marketing surface modules. Blog code must not depend on them so the marketing surface stays extractable into its own repository.
API modules must not import UI layers. Move shared helpers to src/libs or src/constants.
Shared lib modules must not import UI route or page layers. Move shared helpers to src/libs or src/constants.
Reusable components must not import route or page layers. Pass data/actions in from routes or move shared helpers to src/libs.
Route modules must not import Next.js page entrypoints. Keep page wiring in src/pages and shared helpers in src/libs.

Only the marketing entrypoints src/pages/company and src/pages/easysubway may import the marketing surface modules. Blog routes must not depend on them so the marketing surface stays extractable into its own repository.
Marketing surface modules must not import blog data or page layers. Load data in src/pages/company and pass plain props down so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
Marketing surface modules may only import src/components/branding, the shared brand seam. Other blog components must stay out so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
The company marketing module must not import other route modules. Keep it self-contained so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
Marketing surface modules must not import blog data or page layers. Load data in src/pages/easysubway and pass plain props down so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
Marketing surface modules may only import src/components/branding, the shared brand seam. Other blog components must stay out so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
The product marketing module must not import other route modules. Keep it self-contained so this module stays extractable into its own repository.
